title: A Viewer’s Guide to Election Night

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《Dealbook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的Dealbook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、扎伊兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is a daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《今日》节目。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: How to understand the election results as they roll in on Tuesday night.
sentences.zh: 如何解读周二晚间陆续出炉的选举结果。

sentences.en: Alex Burns on three potential scenarios.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯·伯恩斯将分析三种潜在情境。

sentences.en: It's Monday, November 2nd.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月2日，星期一。

sentences.en: So Alex Burns, it is finally almost election day.
sentences.zh: 那么，亚历克斯·伯恩斯，选举日终于快到了。

sentences.en: It is the day before the election.
sentences.zh: 明天就是选举日了。

sentences.en: It is Erev election day.
sentences.zh: 现在是选举前夕。

sentences.en: And so the first thing I want to do is congratulate you for your endurance, especially when it comes to the daily.
sentences.zh: 所以，我首先想做的是祝贺你的毅力，特别是在《今日》节目方面。

sentences.en: I think the term you're looking for is mazel tov.
sentences.zh: 我想你要找的词是“恭喜”（mazel tov）。

sentences.en: Yeah, thank you.
sentences.zh: 是的，谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And a big mazel to you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 也恭喜你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: And to you as well.
sentences.zh: 也恭喜你。

sentences.en: The reason we want to talk to you on the eve of this election, as opposed to all the other times we've abused your time, is because everybody is about to be
sentences.zh: 我们之所以想在选举前夕采访你，而不是像往常那样占用你的时间，是因为从明天晚上7点开始，

sentences.en: inundated with data starting at 7 p.m.
sentences.zh: 每个人都将被数据淹没。

sentences.en: tomorrow night.
sentences.zh: 明天晚上。

sentences.en: And we want to help people make sense of what those results are going to mean as they come in.
sentences.zh: 我们想帮助人们理解这些结果在陆续出炉时意味着什么。

sentences.en: And so if we are successful in this conversation, Alex, I think what we will have created is a bit of a user's guide for election night, if that makes sense.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我们这次谈话成功的话，亚历克斯，我想我们已经为选举之夜制作了一份用户指南，如果这样说得通的话。

sentences.en: It does.
sentences.zh: 说得通。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So guide us, if you would.
sentences.zh: 那么，请指引我们吧。

sentences.en: How do you think about the way things will unfold tomorrow night, all the various permutations of it?
sentences.zh: 你认为明天晚上事情会如何发展，以及各种可能的情况？

sentences.en: Well, the big disclaimer up front is that these are our expectations for how tomorrow night might unfold.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先要声明的是，这些只是我们对明天晚上可能发生情况的预期。

sentences.en: We have done a lot of looking at the ballot counting procedures, at what different state authorities say they think they are going to be doing tomorrow night.
sentences.zh: 我们仔细研究了计票程序，以及各州当局对明天晚上工作安排的表态。

sentences.en: The campaigns have their own expectations for how this might unfold.
sentences.zh: 竞选团队对事态发展也有他们自己的预期。

sentences.en: But above all of that is just the reality that we've never had an election like this before.
sentences.zh: 但最重要的是，现实情况是我们从未经历过这样的选举。

sentences.en: So it's possible that we will have these expectations and they will be totally shattered by what actually happens on election night.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们可能怀有这些预期，但它们可能会被选举之夜实际发生的事情完全打破。

sentences.en: It's possible the counting could be much faster, possible it could be much slower.
sentences.zh: 计票速度可能快得多，也可能慢得多。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But with that giant asterisk, I think we can anticipate three broad scenarios for how election night will unfold.
sentences.zh: 但带着这个巨大的星号，我认为我们可以预见选举之夜的三种大致情境。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: What is the first of those broad scenarios?
sentences.zh: 第一种大致情境是什么？

sentences.en: The first scenario would be that Joe Biden scores a significant win in one of the states that we
sentences.zh: 第一种情境是乔·拜登在我们

sentences.en: expect to count their votes the fastest, like Florida, North Carolina, Georgia, Arizona.
sentences.zh: 预计计票最快的州取得重大胜利，比如佛罗里达州、北卡罗来纳州、佐治亚州、亚利桑那州。

sentences.en: These are states that have well-developed, for the most part, mail-in and early balloting systems,
sentences.zh: 这些州在很大程度上拥有完善的邮寄投票和提前投票系统，

sentences.en: and they have local laws that allow election officials to begin preparing to count or actually count the votes before election day.
sentences.zh: 并且有地方法律允许选举官员在选举日之前就开始准备计票或实际计票。

sentences.en: A state like Florida, in part because of the huge population of seniors, because of the high incidence of natural disasters like hurricanes, has used mail-in voting
sentences.zh: 像佛罗里达州这样的州，部分原因是老年人口众多，以及飓风等自然灾害频发，多年来一直使用邮寄投票

sentences.en: for years and years and years.
sentences.zh: 方式。

sentences.en: So it's a very well-developed and efficient and reliable system of voting, or at least as reliable as a voting system can be in the state of Florida.
sentences.zh: 因此，这是一个非常完善、高效且可靠的投票系统，或者说至少在佛罗里达州，它能达到投票系统所能达到的可靠程度。

sentences.en: So we are expecting Florida first and foremost, but then a couple of those other states in the South and Southwest that I mentioned to move pretty quickly.
sentences.zh: 所以我们预计佛罗里达州首当其冲，然后是我提到的南部和西南部的那几个州，计票速度会相当快。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So to continue this scenario, one of these states,
sentences.zh: 那么继续这个情境，如果其中一个州，

sentences.en: North Carolina, for example, or Florida, or Georgia, goes to Biden somewhat early in the evening, why does that become so meaningful?
sentences.zh: 比如北卡罗来纳州、佛罗里达州或佐治亚州，在傍晚较早时候被拜登拿下，为什么这意义如此重大？

sentences.en: So if Biden wins one of those states, and especially if he wins
sentences.zh: 如果拜登赢得了其中一个州，尤其是如果他赢得了

sentences.en: Florida, which is the biggest electoral college prize among the traditional swing states, that's a sign
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达州——这是传统摇摆州中选举人票最多的州——那是一个信号，

sentences.en: that the larger architecture of President Trump's electoral map is really, really flawed.
sentences.zh: 表明特朗普总统选举版图的整体架构存在非常、非常严重的缺陷。

sentences.en: There are not a lot of Republicans who believe that the president can win this race without Florida.
sentences.zh: 没有多少共和党人相信总统能在没有佛罗里达州的情况下赢得这场竞选。

sentences.en: And when I say not a lot of them, I mean, I have not spoken to a single one who believes that the president can win the race without Florida.
sentences.zh: 当我提到“没有多少”时，我的意思是，我还没跟任何一个相信总统能在没有佛罗里达州的情况下获胜的人交谈过。

sentences.en: You know, the same is kind of true for Georgia, because that's a state that even a month ago, Republicans did not really think Joe Biden had a good shot at winning it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，佐治亚州的情况也差不多，因为即使在一个月前，共和党人也不认为乔·拜登有很大机会赢得该州。

sentences.en: They thought it was going to be closer than it ever had been before.
sentences.zh: 他们认为选情会比以往任何时候都更加胶着。

sentences.en: But at the end of the day, it's a Republican state with red DNA, and it's just not going to happen.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，这是一个有着红色基因的共和党州，这种情况本不该发生。

sentences.en: I don't know a lot of Republicans today who are willing to be quite so confident in their chances there.
sentences.zh: 今天我认识的共和党人中，没几个愿意对他们在那里获胜的机会表现得那么自信。

sentences.en: So under this first scenario, where it seems pretty clear pretty early that Joe Biden is going to have a good night or a very good
sentences.zh: 所以，在第一种情境下，如果很早就清楚乔·拜登将度过一个美好的夜晚，或者一个非常美好的

sentences.en: night, we would see that starting to manifest itself in several or all of these states.
sentences.zh: 夜晚，我们就会看到这种迹象开始在其中几个或所有这些州显现出来。

sentences.en: And I was just to be mathematically very clear, why does President Trump need to win Florida to win re-election?
sentences.zh: 为了数学上的严谨，我想问一下，为什么特朗普总统必须赢得佛罗里达州才能连任？

sentences.en: So if you recall from four years ago, the president won 306 votes in the electoral college.
sentences.zh: 如果你还记得四年前的情况，总统在选举人团中获得了306张选票。

sentences.en: You need 270 to win.
sentences.zh: 你需要270张才能获胜。

sentences.en: Florida has 29.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达州有29张。

sentences.en: So I wasn't a math major, but if you subtract 29 from
sentences.zh: 我虽然不是数学专业的，但如果你用306减去29，

sentences.en: 306, you get 277, which means he can, in theory, win re-election without Florida.
sentences.zh: 结果是277，这意味着理论上他可以在没有佛罗里达州的情况下连任。

sentences.en: It just means he has to win everything else on the map.
sentences.zh: 这只是意味着他必须赢得版图上的其他所有州。

sentences.en: So if he carries Florida, he has a lot more room for error in the upper Midwest, in even the SouthweSt. If he loses Florida, then whatever the second state is that he
sentences.zh: 所以，如果他拿下了佛罗里达州，他在中西部北部甚至西南部就有更多的容错空间。如果他输掉了佛罗里达州，那么他从2016年版图中

sentences.en: loses off his 2016 map, that defeats him.
sentences.zh: 丢失的第二个州，就会导致他失败。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So in this scenario, the kind of early night for Biden scenario, here is an admittedly risky question.
sentences.zh: 那么在这种情境下，即拜登早早获胜的情境，这里有一个公认的风险问题。

sentences.en: How likely is this scenario under the current conditions of polling by places like the Times and others?
sentences.zh: 根据《纽约时报》和其他机构目前的民调情况，这种情境发生的可能性有多大？

sentences.en: So I think the likelihood that Biden wins one of these states is pretty high.
sentences.zh: 我认为拜登赢得其中一个州的概率相当高。

sentences.en: I think that his campaign feels quite confident about Arizona and pretty optimistic about several of the others.
sentences.zh: 我认为他的竞选团队对亚利桑那州感到相当自信，对其他几个州也相当乐观。

sentences.en: I think Democrats in general get very, very nervous about the state of Florida.
sentences.zh: 我认为民主党人总体上对佛罗里达州的选情感到非常、非常紧张。

sentences.en: They just feel like they can run really, really good campaigns there.
sentences.zh: 他们只是觉得他们可以在那里开展非常、非常好的竞选活动。

sentences.en: And it just, you know, Lucy pulls away the football at the end.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，就像露西最后把橄榄球抽走了一样。

sentences.en: But I would say overall, the likelihood that one of these states goes to Biden, pretty high.
sentences.zh: 但我总体认为，其中一个州被拜登拿下的概率相当高。

sentences.en: Two states go to Biden, you know, reasonably good shot at that.
sentences.zh: 两个州被拜登拿下，你知道，可能性也相当大。

sentences.en: The Florida scenario is the one that I think is really a sort of a coin toss at this point.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达州的情境是我认为目前真正处于五五开状态的。

sentences.en: I don't think either side can say with any particular confidence that they expect to win Florida early in the night.
sentences.zh: 我不认为任何一方能特别自信地说他们预计会在当晚早些时候赢得佛罗里达州。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So what is the second broad scenario for the viewing public tomorrow night?
sentences.zh: 那么，明天晚上观众看到的第二种大致情境是什么？

sentences.en: So we just talked about the scenario where Joe Biden has one or two or more breakthrough wins early in the night in those Republican leaning states.
sentences.zh: 我们刚才谈到了乔·拜登在当晚早些时候在那些倾向共和党的州取得一次或多次突破性胜利的情境。

sentences.en: I think scenario number two is that the president holds on in all of them or in all of them that are called early in the night.
sentences.zh: 我认为第二种情境是总统守住了所有这些州，或者守住了所有在当晚早些时候宣布结果的州。

sentences.en: That signals to us that it's going to be, you know, a relatively close race or a very close race in the electoral
sentences.zh: 这向我们发出信号，选举人团的竞争将是相对胶着或非常胶着的，

sentences.en: college and that we're going to need to wait on the Midwest to find out who actually wins this election.
sentences.zh: 我们需要等待中西部地区的结果才能知道谁真正赢得了这次选举。

sentences.en: This is not a far-fetched scenario where the president, despite his overall unpopularity,
sentences.zh: 如果总统尽管整体不受欢迎，

sentences.en: manages to win in places like Florida, North Carolina, and Georgia, which are closely divided states, but where Republicans tend to win far more than Democrats.
sentences.zh: 却设法在佛罗里达州、北卡罗来纳州和佐治亚州这些选情胶着但共和党倾向性更强的州获胜，这并非遥不可及的情境。

sentences.en: If the president wins them, it doesn't tell us that he's going to win the election overall, but it tells us that he is still very, very much in the fight.
sentences.zh: 如果总统赢了这些州，并不意味着他会赢得整个选举，但它告诉我们他仍然非常有竞争力。

sentences.en: And Alex, why doesn't the president winning a state like Florida pretty early in the night not signal a win for him if it more or less does start to signal a win for
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯，为什么总统在当晚较早时候赢得像佛罗里达州这样的州，并不预示着他的胜利，而如果拜登赢得佛罗里达州，却在很大程度上开始预示着他的胜利呢？

sentences.en: Biden if he wins Florida?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样？

sentences.en: Why would that be?
sentences.zh: 你知道，思考目前这场竞选差异的一种方式是，乔·拜登拥有显著的全国领先优势。

sentences.en: You know, one of the ways to think about the disparity in this race right now, Joe Biden has this significant national lead.
sentences.zh: 显著的全国领先优势能为你带来什么，就是让你在许多不同的州都具有竞争力。

sentences.en: What a significant national lead does for you is it makes you competitive in a lot of different states.
sentences.zh: 当你能在许多不同的州竞争时，你就有很多种方法达到270张选票。

sentences.en: And when you're competitive in a lot of different states, you have a lot of different ways to count to 270.
sentences.zh: 这就是乔·拜登在进入选举日时所处的地位。

sentences.en: That is the position that Joe Biden finds himself in heading into election day.
sentences.zh: 所以总统需要做的是封堵拜登的所有这些路径。

sentences.en: So what the president needs to do is close off all of those paths to Biden.
sentences.zh: 拜登只需要找到一条对他有效的路径。

sentences.en: Biden only needs to find one path that works for him.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果总统拿下了佛罗里达州，这就封堵了拜登达到270张选票的一种方式。

sentences.en: So if the president takes Florida, that closes off one way for Biden to count to 270.
sentences.zh: 但这并不一定能让总统达到270张，除非他同时也设法赢得了铁锈地带或中西部北部至少一个大州，

sentences.en: But it doesn't necessarily get the president to 270 unless he has also managed to win at least one of the big states
sentences.zh: 并在北卡罗来纳州、佐治亚州甚至德克萨斯州等地遏制住拜登。

sentences.en: in the Rust Belt or the upper Midwest and push back Biden in a place like North Carolina and Georgia and even Texas.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果第一个大州的结果倾向于总统，不要必然将其视为总统连任在望的信号。

sentences.en: So don't necessarily take that first big call if it goes to the president as a sign that the president is on track to reelection.
sentences.zh: 将其视为他拥有连任路径的信号。

sentences.en: Take it as a sign that he has a path to reelection.
sentences.zh: 对于特朗普总统来说，在这次选举中，他似乎是以明显的劣势进入计票阶段的，这将是一个非常、非常受欢迎的发展。

sentences.en: And that for President Trump would be a very, very welcome development in an election where he does seem to be going into the count as a significant underdog.
sentences.zh: 所以第二种情境，为了明确起见，是特朗普在当晚开始时表现得相当不错。

sentences.en: So this second scenario, just so I'm clear, is one in which Trump starts to do reasonably well at the beginning of the night.
sentences.zh: 但这实际上只是意味着他挡住了拜登。

sentences.en: But that really just means that he's holding Biden off.
sentences.zh: 这并不一定意味着他即将连任。

sentences.en: It does not necessarily mean he's headed for reelection.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 如果总统以较大优势赢得了佛罗里达州，或者结果证明，

sentences.en: And if the president were to somehow win Florida by a wide margin, or it turned out that,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们所有的民调都显示佐治亚州选情非常胶着，但实际上特朗普总统以六七个百分点的优势赢了它。

sentences.en: you know, all our polls suggest that Georgia is a very close race and actually President Trump wins it by six or seven points.
sentences.zh: 我认为，这将是一个巨大的红色闪烁警告信号，表明我们在衡量这次选举的方式上出了大问题。

sentences.en: That, I think, would be a big red blinking warning sign that something has been very wrong in the way we have been measuring this election.
sentences.zh: 但在总统以微弱优势赢得这些州的世界里——这目前是共和党人认为他最好的情况——

sentences.en: But in a world where the president wins those states very narrowly, which currently is what Republicans think is his best case scenario,
sentences.zh: 那么不，这并不能告诉我们他现在突然走上了连任的坦途。

sentences.en: then no, it doesn't tell us that he is now suddenly on a glide path to reelection.
sentences.zh: 那么在这种情境下，当晚稍晚时候，什么迹象表明特朗普总统正走向连任，而不仅仅是阻挡了乔·拜登？

sentences.en: So what would be the sign a little later in the night under this scenario that President Trump is headed toward reelection, not just keeping Joe Biden at bay?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为在选举之夜，除了我们已经讨论过的那些州之外，最重要的州是威斯康星州。

sentences.en: You know, I think the most important state outside the ones we have been talking about already on election night is Wisconsin.
